Background outside the silhouette is flat uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Aspect 1:1.

arguments.Prompt: A tangent-space normal map texture of the exact character shown in Reference-1.png, maintaining the identical silhouette, framing, size, and pose pixel-aligned. Standard OpenGL tangent-space normal map conventions: flat surfaces directly facing the viewer are smooth lavender-blue (#8080FF), surfaces facing right are reddish, surfaces facing up are greenish, surfaces facing left are cyan, and surfaces facing down are purplish. The 3D surface curvature and sculpted volume of the face, hood, cloth folds, staff, and hands are smoothly encoded as normal map vectors. No diffuse texture color, no costume colors, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no specular highlights, no outlines, no text. The entire background outside the character silhouette is completely flat, solid, uniform vivid magenta #FF00FF.
